about: Every synced workspace key (src/lib/mergeWorkspace.ts · MERGE_POLICY, the rows that are not
'local') and every map entity kind (src/types.ts · EntityKind), with the WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_VERSION
(src/lib/workspace.ts) its builds first carried it at.
A build rebuilds the blob from the keys and kinds it knows, so its next save deletes the rest.
The server refuses a save from a build OLDER than the blob (backend app/workspace_kinds.py ·
refuse_older_build), but not one at the same version. So a new key or kind gets the NEXT
version here AND bumps WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_VERSION to it.
`shipped` is the fingerprint of each version's set, the baseline from 25.11.2026 on (earlier
releases at one version did not all carry the same set). Never edit a shipped line: add the line
for a new version. src/lib/workspaceManifest.test.ts checks all of it.
